Use case: ui-mockup. A polished landscape 16:9 concept screenshot for the existing Czech children's math RPG Little Math Adventure. This is a design preview, not a production bitmap button. Match the supplied actual game references: painted fantasy stone architecture, restrained dark navy/teal panels, warm aged gold frames, blue crystals, friendly small illustrated characters. Preserve artwork aspect ratios and complete borders. Use the SAME canonical frame design across related controls; generous safe content insets and clearly separated regions. Children cannot rely on reading: explain with large clear pictures and simple cause/effect arrows. DO NOT DRAW ANY LETTERS, WORDS, NUMERALS OR PSEUDO-TEXT, including in the background. Leave the specifically requested text plates empty; exact short Czech labels and numbers will be composed later in code. Never generate paragraphs. When rendering icon states together, use identical silhouette, pose, scale and alignment; only glow or small particles may change. No whole-button scaling, no crowded bars, no overlapping elements, no tiny symbols, no cropped ornaments. This is a composed scene preview, so use the game scenery as background; flat chroma backgrounds are for later isolated production assets, not this review image. No watermark, no mobile device frame.
Primary request: show the first gentle introduction to two learning routes from Zyx. Image 1 is the room/style reference, image 2 is the existing Zyx identity and frame reference, image 3 is the canonical personal rune fox. Build one inviting 16:9 game screen, no letterboxing.
Layout: softly dimmed guild room in the background. A large waist-up Zyx at left in a round golden portrait frame around x=15%, y=49%, friendly and pointing toward the choices. A small floating gold exclamation mark shape above him is allowed as an icon, but absolutely no text.
Two equal-sized choice cards occupying x=31–59% and x=65–93%, y=23–80%. Both share the same dark blue and gold frame, equal importance, neither preselected. A long EMPTY title plate centered at x=63%, y=13%, spanning 50% of the width.
LEFT card: top half shows a simple familiar arithmetic practice scene illustrated by a small parchment with ONLY three apples and two apples, plus a curved repeat arrow (no digits/operators). Bottom half: large stone catacomb arch, closed ornate door with one star lock and the friendly orange blue-rune fox visible as the promised companion beside the door. A short route of glowing footprints connects practice to the door. Clear progressive relationship, not an instant free pet.
RIGHT card: a small red-haired girl knight climbs three wide rising steps on an adventure map, ending next to a larger shining sword and a group of red heart icons; use a forward arrow and a newly appearing additional heart to communicate increasing strength and health.
Under EACH card, one large matching empty dark action plate, centers x=45%,79%, y=87%, width=28%, height=10%, ready for Czech labels later. Keep this exact empty space and do not fill it with ornaments.
The child must see “practise familiar things toward my fox” versus “adventure forward toward stronger attacks and more hearts” through the pictures alone. Calm inviting mood, no timers, no danger, no cash penalties shown.

Primary request: show the two-player PRE-BATTLE learning-mode chooser as it could look in the real game. Image 1 gives the actual arena background; Image 2 gives the just-designed canonical learning-choice cards, icon metaphors and gold/blue frame design. Same image language as that design, slightly simplified for the recurring choice. Full-bleed 16:9, no black bands.
Dimmed Silverpond arena background with opponents faintly visible at the sides. One centered blue-enamel and gold frame panel covering x=12–88%, y=8–94%. Long EMPTY title plate at top x=50%, y=15%, width=50%, height=9%.
Inside two horizontal player rows, well separated and equally sized: row one centered at y=37%, row two at y=64%. Each has a large circular child-character portrait at x=23%: first the canonical red-haired girl knight; second another girl knight with dark hair and a blue cape in the same chibi game style. No names or numbers on the portraits; leave a little empty badge on their bottom edge for an owner number.
To the right of EACH portrait are exactly TWO matching wide choice controls, centered x=47% and x=71%, width=21%, height=22%. Their upper region holds a LARGE picture icon, their bottom 35% is a perfectly EMPTY dark label strip. LEFT control repeats the practice icon: familiar parchment with five apples and a curved repeat arrow, a small fox medallion. RIGHT control repeats the advance icon: ascending trail with a forward arrow, a sword and a heart. Keep repeated icon copies identical in silhouette, pose and scale between rows.
The top player's LEFT option is selected with a small gold CHECK badge and a restrained cyan rim glow. The bottom player's RIGHT option is selected with the same check and rim glow. The other two choices remain neutral. Frame geometries do not change between selected and neutral controls.
One shared EMPTY action button centered x=50%, y=86%, width=30%,height=10%, with a crossed-swords icon on its left and empty label region.
Communicate that each child chooses independently, and they then enter the SAME battle together. No timers, no warning signs, no red-versus-green ranking of learning routes. No lettering or digits anywhere.

Primary request: a full gameplay concept screenshot demonstrating a much clearer attack contribution above a math problem. Image 1 is the REAL MathBoard and hero layout reference, image 2 is the exact canonical parchment style, image 3 supplies the Silverpond battle background. Preserve the recognisable shared parchment MathBoard and the game art language; do not replace it with a modern dashboard.
Full-bleed Silverpond stone arena with waterfalls in the background. Girl knight and orange rune fox on the bottom left, a friendly blue crab enemy on bottom right. Keep their full bodies below the board and readable. Remove all existing tiny text/HUD numerals.
Main parchment with wooden upright ends takes x=20–80%, y=7–68%, preserve its natural proportions. The paper is warm, open and uncluttered.
At top center of the parchment around x=50%,y=19% place ONE prominent dark gold-edged attack badge width=31%, height=13% of screen. Inside left quarter of badge a large clearly readable sword; leave the middle and right 75% COMPLETELY EMPTY dark surface for numeric values added later. It should support a large base value and optional bonus; do not fill empty area with decorations.
Below this badge, keep a broad EMPTY paper band around x=50%,y=36%, width=46%, height=15% for a large arithmetic expression to be composed in code later. No equation, numerals or placeholder marks.
Below that are exactly THREE matching empty wooden answer buttons centered at x=36%,50%,64%, y=55%, each width=11%,height=10% of screen. Same canonical frame and alignment. All neutral, none green, no correct answer indicated.
Bottom-right of the parchment at x=72%,y=64% include a little empty round gold socket for a future speed symbol, but leave it empty. Bottom-left edge of parchment three small empty progress circles. Do not draw a thin speed-charge meter anywhere.
At bottom center of screen a modest EMPTY dark gold-bordered attack-total badge, x=50%,y=89%, width=18%,height=10%, with a sword on its left and empty number area.
The composition should make the paper's big attack badge the second focal point after the problem. Large clear safe areas for precise math and dynamically rendered feedback. No words, numbers, formulae or pseudo-glyphs anywhere.

Primary request: a clear child-readable VICTORY reward screen celebrating personal improvement and practice progress. Image 1 is the exact blue-enamel/pearl Silverpond results-frame reference; remove its prose-heavy content entirely. Image 2 supplies the newly designed practice/pet route visual language. Image 3 is the personal rune fox.
Full-bleed 16:9, calm dimmed Silverpond stone arena background. One large consistent blue and gold results frame at x=13–87%, y=8–92%. EMPTY title plate centered at x=50%,y=16%, width=45%,height=10%.
Within the frame three clearly separated, generously spaced horizontal picture rows:
Row 1 at y=33%: a neat small pile of the game's bronze/silver/gold coins at x=34%. A large EMPTY dark gold-rimmed numeric medallion at x=58%,width=20%,height=10%. This is the ordinary battle reward, visually neutral and assured.
Row 2 at y=51%: a GOLDEN WINGED BOOT with a small lightning spark at x=29%, a clear arrow at x=43%, THREE large cyan faceted mana crystals at x=55%,62%,69%. Leave a spacious EMPTY short-label line above this row at x=50%,y=42%,width=45%,height=5%. Show a subtle ghost of the same boot behind it to suggest improving your own previous performance, no rival player or clock.
Row 3 at y=70%: an illustrated open learning book at x=28%, then a short horizontal path of FOUR clearly separated rune stones / skill tokens, the first three gently glowing cyan and the fourth empty. This path leads to a SMALL CLOSED catacomb arch at x=72% with a familiar rune fox medallion above it. This is progress toward access, not granting the fox from every ordinary battle. Leave an EMPTY compact short-label line at x=50%,y=61%,width=40%,height=5%.
At x=50%,y=86% one EMPTY wide action plate, same blue/gold frame, a single continue-arrow icon on its right. No coins crossed out, no cash penalties. Separate coin reward, personal-speed mana bonus, and skill progress. The golden speed boot must be visually distinct from blue mana crystals.
All values and Czech labels will be added in code: do not generate any words, numbers, graph labels or placeholder text.

Primary request: a personal companion reward/upgrade screen after one child's catacomb trial, in the existing game style. Image 1 gives the guild/catacomb surroundings, image 2 is the canonical orange fox with cyan rune markings, image 3 gives the agreed dark blue/gold frame design and red-haired girl knight. Full 16:9 landscape.
Background the familiar guild hall and catacomb doorway, softly dimmed. One centered ornate blue/gold reward panel x=15–85%, y=10–91%. One completely EMPTY title plate centered x=50%, y=18%, width=48%,height=10%.
The left half of the panel contains ONE full-body canonical rune fox, large, beautiful and friendly, at x=38%, y=52%; preserve orange fur, white muzzle/tail-tip and cyan body runes, complete body/tail inside its content area. The fox is alive and a loyal companion, not a collectible item in a shop. A SMALL circular portrait of the red-haired girl knight is fixed to the fox's round portrait frame upper-left edge near x=24%,y=35% to convey whose pet this is.
The right half contains a large elegant EMPTY horizontal power medallion centered x=66%,y=48%, width=27%,height=13%, with a clearly recognisable golden PAW icon occupying only its left 25%, and a broad empty dark area for later numeric '5 to 6' display. Below it at x=66%,y=64% show THREE rune stones with a soft blue glow, with the newest one brighter. Leave an EMPTY short-label area centered x=66%,y=34%,width=25%,height=7%.
A short tasteful trail of small blue sparkles connects the newly lit rune to the fox's cyan markings. No second fox, no rival child, no treasure price, no numerical stat labels.
One EMPTY confirmation button centered x=50%,y=83%,width=32%,height=10%, with a small check icon at its right. The layout should instantly communicate “this is YOUR fox; it grew stronger after YOUR trial.” All labels and power numerals will be overlaid later, so absolutely no generated lettering or numerals.
